The rank sequence uniquely determines B=J_1(1)+J_(2L-1)(0)+J_L(0)^(L-4)+J_1(0). The nilpotent block and invertible fixed component give exact first-entry counts and sharp extremal probability. Standalone verifier checked independent matrix ranks at L=4,8,16,32 and exhaustive L=4 3x3 state transitions.
